name: Lamp
desc: A Simple device, designed to emit visible light. Sometimes affixed to helmets or even Weapons.

name: Jumpers
desc: These boots allow their wearer to jump incredible heights, trailing thin whisps of glowing vapor.

name: Anchor
desc: Under the clawed fingers of this gauntlet, friction is amplified 10-fold.

name: Skates
desc: Thin rails on the bottom of the sole which insulate the user from friction, increasing their speed.

name: Imaginary Pocket
desc: Despite the appearance of a loop of steel, an Imaginary Pocket contains a non-local space of arbitrary size, perfect for storing impossible mass.

name: Flicker Tag
desc: Paired cuffs and a storage device, a Flicker tag enables easy disposal and access to a select Item.

name: Shimmerweave
desc: Residue woven in moving patterns that flow through cloth, Shimmerweave sign of extreme prestige in Verdun high society.

name: Scopes
desc: Lenses given the ability to focus light by Artifice. These allow the wearer to see impossibly far distances.

name: Orrery
desc: A model of Gaia and the Sun at a cartoonish scale, woven from light projected by a small orb.

name: Recorder
desc: Delicate bronze tubes bound to a sensitive, Residue hardened needle. A Recorder encodes sounds onto these tubes, called Scrolls, as tiny gyrating scratches.

name: Player
desc: The inverse of a Recorder, a dull needle designed to convey vibration to a curved metal amplifier.

name: Sigil Rune
desc: Carefully designed to appear like a normal Verdun Crown Post (the object to which a formal top-knot is tied) but able to emit a ghostly semblance of a Rune or Seal.

name: Burner
desc: Concentric rings of metal capable of emitting flames and ambient heat. Typically used for cooking or to warm an area.

name: Conduit
desc: Capable of creating a vacuum, Conduits are used to transport liquids within Arks, but can also be used to collect or dispense anything fit for a pipe.

name: Preserver
desc: Enclosed within such a device, decay and, consequently, time itself is arrested for a while. This is employed both in the maintenance of perishable goods as well as some kinds of imprisonment.

name: Link
desc: Links transmit small movements and impulses across surprisingly far distances.

name: Piston
desc: Drive in a box, capable of providing steady pushing force over longer periods of time.

name: Relay
desc: An advanced component of larger structures of Artifice or devices of convenience, Relays serve an extremely wide range of uses.

name: Safety Net
desc: Deceptively decorative, this mesh of Residue-laden thread is typically worn the waist with one's belt sash.

name: Life Mask
desc: The crowning achievement of Artifice, consolidated into an otherwise normal Breathing Apparatus.

name: Personal Ward
desc: Inlay set into the surface of one's Armor, able to project a Ward nearly as durable as a Mage's own.

name: Rime-Bane / Dragon Ward
desc: Inner lining of one's Armor, designed either to expel or generate Heat to resist environmental hazards.

name: Vanishing Bangle
desc: Capable of somehow displacing the light that would touch the wearer, these Items carry an ill repute as assassin's gear.

name: Stasis
desc: Full restraints, tailored for variety. A Stasis locks its wearer in time, like a Preserver, but with more flexible means. This is the common tool for arrest and capture, especially of dangerous subje…

name: Amplification Bands
desc: Usually worn on the arms, Amplification Bands can negate a certain amount of fatigue for their wearer, but prolonged use tends to be very dangerous.

name: Greenlights
desc: Worn over the eyes, Greenlights are a popular inclusion into Expeditioners' Breathing Gear, as the luxury of ample light is not always present in the Shard Sea.

name: Grinder
desc: Voltaic destruction channeled into the tip of a spinning wheel, held in a crude steel harness. More tool than Weapon, Grinders are able to function in either capacity with cruel effect.

name: Booster
desc: While not literally an amplifier of speed or time, a Booster is able to warp its wearer's interaction with cause and effect, shifting their Actions in terms of priority.

name: Cushion
desc: Braces to the legs, a Cushion both insulates their wearer from shock and allows them to lighten their burdons. Very popular for longer Expeditions.

name: Gauntlets of Power
desc: Shrouding the arms in black iron, coursing with veins of glowing blue Residue, these Gauntlets grant the fists supernatural impact.

name: Candle Burst
desc: Light packed into a metal cannister, ready to explode.

name: Helljar
desc: Tightly coiled copper rings binding an unstable Residual core.

name: Breath of Ventus
desc: An extremely lethal explosive, combining some of the most dangerous techniques of Artifice into a small, deceptively innocent package. The titular associating with the rogue god of cyclones and mayhe…

name: Monodron
desc: A spheroid with minimal senses and capacities. Monodrons perform little more than manual functions, but are often useful for automating incredibly simple tasks.

name: Duodron
desc: Loosely patterned after a Verdun, Duodron Automata are useful for moving larger loads from place to place, or crushing stationary Targets.

name: Trion
desc: Little more than an Arquebus with legs, Trions can be tasked to man and reactively shoot to defend positions or, in the hands of more skilled Artificers, even accompany as mobile offense.

name: Flametongue
desc: A powerful combination of Runes that allows the Weapon to be wreathed in deadly flames.

name: Ghost Blade
desc: Pale light which drips from an edge, tracing cuts into swaths of deadly force.

name: Recall
desc: These blades seem to flicker, ever so slightly, instantly returning to the hand when thrown or dropped.

name: Regenerating
desc: One of the most popular for its sheer usefulness.

name: Enhancement
desc: Magically augmented physical connections within the Armor.

name: Abjurance
desc: One of the most desired of all Augmentation Runes, Abjurance can ablate threats and even harmful forces before the wearer is even touched.

name: Flicker Shield
desc: A prototype ward that stutters a moment out of sync, catching a blow before it has fully landed.

name: Auld Lantern
desc: An older design kept for sentiment — its light lingers where you have already been.
